VI._name: SoundVib_OrderTracking.lvlib:OAT Convert to Even Angle Signal (1 Channel).vi
VI.description: Converts an even-time-spaced scaled signal to an even-angle-spaced signal by resampling the acquired signal. Wire data to the scaled signal [EU] input to determine the polymorphic instance to use or manually select the instance.

Indicator.description: even-angle signal returns data resampled at even-angle intervals. This parameter is synchronous to the rotational speed with constant number of samples per revolution.

Control.description: pulse/revolution specifies the number of pulses the tachometer generates during each revolution. The default is 1.

max order specifies the maximum order to analyze. If the value of this parameter is less than or equal to zero\2C this VI automatically sets the maximum order to analyze. The maximum order used might be larger than the one you specify. Review actual max order entry for calculation. The default is 0 (auto).
contains information about tachometer pulse arrival time and the rotational speed at each pulse.

scaled signal [EU] specifies the scaled signal expressed in the selected engineering units. To obtain a properly scaled signal\2C you can use the SVL Scale Voltage to EU VI or define a virtual channel in National Instruments Measurement & Automation Explorer (MAX).

Indicator.type: cluster{string.channel name,string.description,cluster{double.sensor sensitivity,uint16.engineering units,double.dB reference,string.custom label,uint16.weighting filter,double.pregain}. channel info}
Indicator.description: even-angle channel info returns information that you can pass to another VI about the measurement configuration for even-angle signal.
even-angle position info returns the position information of even-angle signals.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.

Control.description: error in describes error conditions that occur before this node runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
analysis method specifies the analysis method this VI uses to convert the scaled signal [EU] to even-angle signal.

Indicator.description: actual max order is the actual measured maximum order this VI uses.

Control.description: reset? specifies the initialization of the internal states. The first time this VI runs\2C or when reset? is TRUE\2C the internal states initialize to zero. If reset? is FALSE\2C this VI sets the internal states to the final states from the previous call to the VI. The default is FALSE.
zero delay? specifies whether a filter delay exists between the input signal and the output signal. The default is FALSE.
